items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Well, he had a good affair band.

ctx.x: Is that the same George Moret who hired you off Governor Nichol Street for your first job?

Yes. Yes. And another man, Oscar Duconge, D-U-C-O-N-G-E is the way I have his spell. Duconge? Duconge. Duconge. Yes. Duconge. Yes. What kind of a band did he have? Well, he had a good affair band. What did he play? Duconge used to play, let me see, I can't remember that. Cornet. Cornet. The brass band wasn't it? Yes. When you had your own band, when you were the leader, what name did you call that? If you were the leader of the band, when did you, in the old days, did you have a name for the band? No, I know. Are…
Well, if you were talking to a young fellow now that was getting ready to be a professional musician, is there any special advice that you would give him?
